description: Create the three test files that validate the modules built in FEAT-001. This feature depends on FEAT-001 being complete. The three files are independent of each other but all depend on FEAT-001 source files.
steps: 1. Create src/tests/contractEvents.test.ts — unit tests using vi.useFakeTimers() and vi.fn() fetch mocks. No module-level vi.mock() needed because fetch is injected via options. Import streamContractEventsRealTime from '../soroban/streamContractEventsRealTime'; decodeContractEvent from '../soroban/decodeContractEvent'; EventIndex from '../soroban/eventIndex'; SorokitErrorCode from '../shared/response'; createMockContractEventGenerator from '../testing/mockEventStream'; ContractEvent from '../soroban/subscribeContractEvents'.

2. streamContractEventsRealTime describe block in contractEvents.test.ts:
   - 'stop() before first tick does not call fetch': useFakeTimers; call stop() immediately; advanceTimersByTimeAsync(5000); expect fetchMock not called.
   - 'onEvent receives events on successful poll': fetchMock returns 1 event; advance 1500ms; expect onEvent called with that event.
   - 'deduplication: same event ID not delivered twice': fetchMock always returns same event; advance 3000ms (2 polls); expect onEvent called once total.
   - 'onError called when fetch throws': fetchMock rejects; advance 1500ms; expect onError called with Error instance.
   - 'backoff doubles on consecutive failures': fetchMock always rejects; spy on globalThis.setTimeout capture delay args; advance through 3 backoff cycles; verify delays approximately 1500, 3000, 6000.
   - 'onReconnect called on attempt > 0 after failure': fetchMock rejects once then resolves; onReconnect spy called with attempt >= 1.

3. decodeContractEvent describe block in contractEvents.test.ts:
   - it.each for malformed inputs: [[null], [undefined], [42], ['string-input'], [[]], [true]] — each should return status 'error' with code CONTRACT_READ_FAILED.
   - 'unknown event type (no ABI)': pass valid event object with name='unknownEvent'; expect status 'ok', data.type === 'unknown'.
   - 'known event type with ABI': pass event with name matching ABI method; expect status 'ok', data.type === 'known'.
   - 'valid event without ABI': pass event object with name/topics/value; expect status 'ok', data.contractId and data.name correct.
   - 'missing value field': pass event without value property; expect status 'ok', data.value is null or undefined.
   - 'event with all undefined fields': pass {} with no recognized fields; expect status 'ok' (not an error since it is an object), data.name === '', data.contractId === ''.

4. EventIndex describe block in contractEvents.test.ts:
   - 'add and size': add 3 distinct events; size() === 3.
   - 'query by contractId': add events for 'C1' and 'C2'; query({ contractId: 'C1' }) returns only C1 events.
   - 'query by ledger range': add events at ledger 1..10; query({ minLedger:3, maxLedger:7 }) returns 5.
   - 'query by name': add transfer and mint events; query({ name: 'mint' }) returns only mints.
   - 'query with custom predicate': query({ predicate: e => e.name === 'transfer' }); returns transfers only.
   - 'deduplicate removes exact duplicates': add same event object twice; deduplicate() === 1; size() === 1.
   - 'hash collision: distinct events with same hash key are both kept': this is verified by checking size after adding two events with different ids that share same hash bucket — size() === 2.
   - 'clear empties index': add events; clear(); size() === 0.

5. Create src/tests/contractEvents.performance.test.ts — performance tests using performance.now(), no fake timers. Import createMockContractEventGenerator from '../testing/mockEventStream'; EventIndex from '../soroban/eventIndex'; streamContractEventsRealTime from '../soroban/streamContractEventsRealTime'; vi from 'vitest'.
   - 'EventIndex: add 10,000 events at >1000 events/sec': generate 10k events; time add loop; assert elapsed < 10_000ms (threshold is loose; actual will be ~50ms).
   - 'EventIndex: query 10,000 events in <200ms': 10k events added; time query({ name: 'transfer' }); assert elapsed < 200ms.
   - 'Mock stream: 1000 events delivered without duplicates': use createMockEventStream with 1000 events; drive streamContractEventsRealTime with vi.useFakeTimers(); advance timers; collect events from onEvent calls; flatten and count unique IDs; assert unique count === 1000.

6. Create src/tests/integration/contractEventStream.test.ts — integration tests using vi.fn() fetch and vi.useFakeTimers(). Import streamContractEventsRealTime from '../../soroban/streamContractEventsRealTime'; createMockContractEventGenerator, createMockEventStream from '../../testing/mockEventStream'; vi, describe, it, expect, beforeEach, afterEach from 'vitest'.
   - 'end-to-end: delivers events from two sequential polls': fetchMock returns different event batches on call 1 and 2; advance timers; expect onEvent called twice with correct events.
   - 'reconnection: onError and onReconnect called, events eventually delivered': fetch rejects 3 times then succeeds; expect onError called 3 times, onReconnect called with attempt values [1,2,3] (or subset), onEvent eventually called.
   - 'backoff delays grow exponentially': fetch always rejects; spy on setTimeout; advance through 3 cycles; assert delay args are 1500, 3000, 6000 (or within 10% tolerance).
   - 'cancellation: stop() during backoff prevents retry': fetch rejects; before backoff timer fires call stop(); advance timers; fetch not called again after stop().
acceptance_criteria: npm test -- contractEvents.test passes all tests (including it.each malformed-input tests)
npm test -- contractEvents.performance.test passes all throughput assertions
npm test -- contractEventStream.test passes all integration tests
npm test (full suite) — no regressions in existing test files
npm run typecheck — no errors across all new test files
findings: All 35 new tests pass. Pre-existing failures (transaction.test.ts syntax error, client.test.ts async generator, submit-transaction.test.ts timeout) are unchanged from FEAT-001. One source fix was required: decodeContractEvent.ts needed Array.isArray guard since arrays pass the isRecord check but should be treated as malformed events per the spec. One test fix was required: onReconnect test updated to send two consecutive failures so attempt>0 before onReconnect is asserted (onReconnect fires on failure when attempt>0, not on success).
